description: This file defines the CssCollectionOptimizerLazy class, which implements CSS asset optimization, grouping, URL generation, and cleanup within Drupal core.

classes.name: CssCollectionOptimizerLazy
classes.description: A class for lazy optimization of CSS collections, including grouping, URL generation, and cleanup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for CSS asset grouping, optimization, theme management, dependency resolution, request handling, file system, configuration, URL generation, timing, and language management.

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Groups CSS assets, prepares URLs with query parameters, and returns an array of optimized asset URLs.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes cached CSS files older than a threshold from the assets directory.

methods.name: optimizeGroup
methods.description: Optimizes a group of CSS assets by concatenating, license commenting, and handling minified/external files, including reordering @import rules.
